meta.title: Da Nang's Largest Live Seafood Market: Giant Tanks Walk [4K POV]
meta.description:
Explore one of Da Nang's largest live seafood markets and restaurants right along Võ Nguyên Giáp beach street!

This raw 4K POV walk takes you inside Làng Cá, featuring massive indoor aquarium tanks packed with live lobsters, giant crabs, sea snails, and rare local ocean catches. Watch how fresh live seafood is selected and served directly to diners in Vietnam.

No talking, no music—just an authentic, real-life audit of Da Nang's live seafood market culture.

📍 Location: Làng Cá Seafood Market & Restaurant, Da Nang, Vietnam

🚶 Format: 4K Ambient Seafood Market Walk

#DaNang #DaNangSeafood #LiveSeafoodMarket #SeafoodMarket #LangCa #MyKheBeach #VietnamPOV #VietnamFood #DaNang4K

1. English
Step inside Da Nang's giant seafood market. Massive tanks hold lobsters and live crabs. Watch fresh seafood selected directly in 4K POV.
